scientific_choices.rationale: Deep-copy the qualified bottleneck and four attention upsampling stages, train them and a zero-initialized Gap head; freeze complete original Text/Kernel path and ResNet50. Source decoder initialization is retained, new decoder BN statistics train. This isolates feature adaptation from damaging M/K; it is not the proposal's final shared-feature architecture.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Learn Gap-specific spatial representations that small frozen-feature heads could not provide, at additional parameter/memory cost.
